specRef: spec-plan.md r4, binding public-operation and own-code amendment to approved r3 sha256 0d7c8345
ownerOverride: OWNER-REQUEST.md 2026-10-23 disclosure section, binding: no private scan repo, everything runs in the public repos, supersedes the spec private-scan design
runtime: public repositories only, no private scan repo or private storage assumed; scan workflows, reports and fix PRs are public; goal zero open vulnerability at all times

inventory.consumerDiscoveryNote: Inventory references only, not new derived-pin permission. L5 consumes root-lock provenance; gateway/probe receipts bind separate release/install locks. Unknown consumers block policy admission.

toolbox.note: Exact approved path fixed at S1 for SECDAILY-EX6, read-only in S1

register.baselineNote: Historical r3 snapshot only; derive current outstanding rows and expiry from each scanned main, never from these baseline counts

grouping.unitKey: repository + repair class + component/lock set or image identity/platform + fixed target

allow: patch-only dependency/range or existing override value with unchanged major/minor including 0.x plus deterministic lock changes
existing image pin digest and associated patch-version tokens in same registry/repository OS release purpose architecture family with attested patch-only delta
declared deterministic derived pins such as l5-root-lock

ownCode.admission: Exact paths require reviewed protected-main policy before authoring; separate lot with before/after reproducer and regression proof; no dependency changes or weakened tests

l5-root-lock.blocker: Current main also binds lockFingerprint, declaredLockSnapshot and toolchainSnapshots in verifyPreCandidate; qualify compatibility at S5a, never broaden the single-field rule at runtime
l5-root-lock.algorithm: replace only that JSON string preserving every other byte, write lowercase sha256 of manifest bytes plus LF to sidecar
l5-root-lock.validator: memory-l5-gate LOT=1 plus verifyPreCandidate, closure-changing bumps refused, no history archive entry

credentials.reader: read-only access on the public repository, Variables read plus Contents read for receipts, used only by controller/watcher and merge jobs, rotation and revocation receipts recorded
credentials.perRepoDisable: global switch first, then protected policy PR in the same public repository

bumpGateManual.rule: dependency-section edits of published packages with bump required go to manual handoff, never automatic scope
bumpGateManual.guard: run publishable-manifest guard locally before publication so the lot never opens

reconciliation.review: independent other-model review plus green CI, then auto-merge within the fixed scope, no per-PR owner GO; fix PRs are public
